question: 2[(425)² + (375)²] - (425 + 375)² = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the algebraic identity: 2(a² + b²) − (a + b)² = (a − b)².

Here, a = 425 and b = 375.

Result = (425 − 375)² = 50².

Result = 2500.

**∴ The correct answer is 2500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** a = 425, b = 375

**Formula Used:** (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

⇒ 2(a² + b²) − (a + b)²

⇒ 2a² + 2b² − (a² + b² + 2ab)

⇒ 2a² + 2b² − a² − b² − 2ab

⇒ a² + b² − 2ab

⇒ (a − b)²

⇒ (425 − 375)²

⇒ 50² = 2500

**∴ The correct answer is 2500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Squares Identity

The expression 2(a² + b²) can be written as the sum of two squares: (a + b)² + (a − b)².

Difference of Squares

The identity a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b) is used to simplify products of sums and differences.

Square of a Binomial

(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² and (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b² are fundamental algebraic expansions.
